prompt: What were the top 5 Billboard songs by musical groups in the year 1985?
answer:
Using Billboard’s 1985 year-end Hot 100 and counting duos as musical groups, the top five were:

| Overall year-end rank | Song | Group |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | **“Careless Whisper”** | Wham! featuring George Michael |
| 3 | **“Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go”** | Wham! |
| 4 | **“I Want to Know What Love Is”** | Foreigner |
| 6 | **“Out of Touch”** | Daryl Hall & John Oates |
| 7 | **“Everybody Wants to Rule the World”** | Tears for Fears |

Madonna’s and Chaka Khan’s songs were excluded because they were solo-artist recordings.
